recommendation: Keep the source fix. The core spec now consistently conveys the approved who-or-what interpretation in both the detailed Meta definition and the active Resource metadata summary; any separate IG Publisher guidance about HL7-authored IGs constraining Provenance remains outside this core source change.
issue_request: FHIR-20906 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I request asking the specification to stop implying that Meta.source corresponds only to Provenance.entity.what and to say it can correspond to either Provenance.agent.who or Provenance.entity.what, while leaving IG-specific constraints to Provenance rather than fixing Meta.source in HL7-authored IGs.
initial_application: Git commit 398a20214d22c6442704b8b2798ebde0d2f7439e initially applied FHIR-20906 by adding Provenance.entity.what[x] or Provenance.agent.who[x] to the Meta.source spreadsheet comment. Related commit 9edd51287b10ae90910262893cc060ad9df66f0b then generalized Meta.source source-granularity wording for FHIR-20688, and later commit 8b8c20776bea89c69032189b5a2260d8d7e0f9b2 updated stale Provenance choice names to current Provenance.entity.what and Provenance.agent.who. The detailed Meta.source definition was correct, but the active Resource metadata summary still mentioned only an implied Provenance.entity.role.
additional_context: FHIR-20688 supports keeping Meta.source broad enough for a resource, abstract identifier, endpoint, or other data source, and FHIR-49878 later clarified Meta.source as a data source rather than only a source system. FHIR-I minutes from 2019-06-17 confirm the FHIR-20906 vote and exact resolution. A later Zulip implementers thread showed continuing who-versus-what ambiguity and supported explicit broad wording. source/fhir.ini confirms Meta and Resource are active build inputs.
reconciliation: Updated source/resource/resource-notes.xml so the Resource metadata summary now says the possible implied Provenance role can be entity.role or agent.role and that Meta.source may correspond to Provenance.entity.what or Provenance.agent.who while still allowing a more general or abstract reference.
source_changes: source/resource/resource-notes.xml: added agent.role and explicit Provenance.entity.what or Provenance.agent.who wording to the Resource metadata summary for Meta.source.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that Meta.source can be a resource, abstract identifier, endpoint, or other broad data source, framing the who-or-what interpretation.

Updated stale Provenance choice-element references so current wording uses Provenance.entity.what and Provenance.agent.who.
